title: River Crossing Time and Drift Formula

variables.d: Width of the river between parallel banks
variables.v_{B/R}: Speed of boat/swimmer relative to water
variables.\\theta: Steering angle measured upstream from the bank normal
variables.x: Net horizontal drift downstream along the opposite bank

assumptions: Uniform river current velocity across width d
Constant speed relative to water v_{B/R}
validity_conditions: Shortest crossing time occurs at theta = 0; zero drift requires v_{B/R} >= v_R and sin(theta) = v_R / v_{B/R}
common_misuse: Attempting zero drift when swimmer speed is slower than river current (v_{B/R} < v_R)
